physicalNotes: Radius 1.45 +/- 0.1 solar radii from Barber et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of IRAS 04125+2902 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024Natur.635..574B/abstract): 1,008,765 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
